cohort: 89 women hospitalised at an Obstetrics and Gynaecology Clinical Hospital between 2011-2013, including those diagnosed with threatened preterm labour (with or without tocolytic treatment) and a control group with normally progressing pregnancy.
finding: Groups with threatened preterm labour (with or without tocolytic treatment) and the control group differed significantly in the week of delivery and body mass at birth, but no significant differences were found in cytokine profiles among groups, and progesterone treatment was not observed to be suitable for threatened preterm labour.
gest_age: 23 to <37 weeks of gestation for the threatened preterm labour groups
